title: Reliability of large language model–generated clinical reasoning in assisted reproductive technology
core_idea: Evaluate the clinical reliability of LLM-generated clinical chains-of-thought in reproductive medicine and test whether different prompting strategies (zero-shot, random few-shot, selective few-shot) affect quality, using a blinded comparative evaluation by senior assisted reproductive technology clinicians and comparison with an AI evaluator (GPT-4o).
tldr: A blinded comparative study to assess whether LLM-generated clinical reasoning is reliable for assisted reproductive technology and to examine how different prompting strategies influence the quality of generated clinical chains-of-thought, based on expert clinician evaluations and an AI model comparison.
